cover.bottom: AND BOGO CAKE SEPT. 29 TO OCT. 4

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons search for coffee cups counter doughnuts cafe
photo.prompt: dramatic close-up of hot coffee cups and glazed doughnuts on a cafe counter, morning light, South Florida feel

slides.headline: Dunkin': Free medium coffee today
slides.body: Dunkin’ Rewards members get a free medium hot or iced coffee with any purchase on Sept. 29 through the Dunkin’ app.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons search for Dunkin coffee cup storefront
photo.prompt: dramatic close-up of a Dunkin coffee cup on a counter with orange and pink signage blurred behind it

slides.headline: Krispy Kreme: Free coffee with any purchase
slides.body: Krispy Kreme guests get a free small or medium hot or iced coffee with any purchase on Sept. 29 at participating locations, limit one per guest.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons search for Krispy Kreme doughnuts coffee
photo.prompt: close-up of glazed doughnuts beside an iced coffee cup under Krispy Kreme neon-style lighting

slides.headline: Smoothie King: Free 12 oz protein coffee
slides.body: Healthy Rewards members get a free 12 oz Coffee High Protein Almond Mocha Smoothie on Sept. 29 at participating locations, limit one per member.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons search for smoothie cup counter
photo.prompt: dramatic close-up of a chocolate coffee protein smoothie in a clear cup on a bright shop counter

slides.headline: Nothing Bundt Cakes: BOGO Bundtlets to Oct. 4
slides.body: Check for an email from Nothing Bundt Cakes with a unique BOGO Bundtlets code, valid in-store and online through Oct. 4 at select locations.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons search for bundt cake bakery display
photo.prompt: dramatic bakery case close-up with small frosted bundt cakes lined up under warm display lights

slides.headline: Cinnabon: Free small coffee code in the app
slides.body: Cinnabon loyalty members can enter COFFEEDAY26 in the app on Sept. 29 for a free small coffee reward while supplies last, redeemable through Oct. 31.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons search for Cinnabon cinnamon roll coffee
photo.prompt: close-up of a frosted cinnamon roll beside a small coffee cup on a mall food court table

slides.headline: Circle K: Free medium coffee today
slides.body: Inner Circle members get one free medium hot or iced coffee on Sept. 29 through the Circle K app, limit one redemption per member.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons search for Circle K coffee cup store
photo.prompt: dramatic close-up of a convenience-store coffee cup beside a self-serve coffee machine with red store signage in the background
